prompt:
Rewrite snippets/order-tracking-timeline.liquid so it renders an order tracking timeline exactly as specified below. Inputs. All inputs are top-level variables. There is no section object. - `title`: string or null. - `tracking_number`: string or null. - `events`: array of objects. It is never null but may be empty. Each object has: - `label`: string, never null. - `date`: string or null. - `note`: string or null. - `done`: boolean. Text handling. Trim leading and trailing whitespace from every text value before testing it or outputting it. Treat null as an empty string. HTML-escape every value you output. Rules: 1. Ignore any event whose trimmed label is empty. Do not render it and do not consider it when choosing the current step. 2. If no events remain after rule 1, output nothing at all (an empty string). This means no wrapper and no tracking line. 3. Otherwise, output the following with no whitespace between or around any tags, in this order: a. If the trimmed title is non-empty: `
` immediately followed by `

TITLE

`. b. If the trimmed tracking_number is non-empty: `

Tracking: NUMBER

`. c. `
    `, then one `
  1. ` per remaining event in input order, then `
`. d. `
`, but only if the section was opened in step a. When the title is null or blank there is no section element and no h2. The tracking paragraph (if any) and the ol are output at top level. 4. The class attribute of each li is: - `step step--done` when done is true; - `step step--pending` otherwise. The last remaining event (in input order) whose done is true gets ` step--current` appended, giving class="step step--done step--current". Only that one event gets it. If no remaining event is done, no li has step--current. 5. Each li contains, in this order: - `LABEL`; - then `DATE`, only if the trimmed date is non-empty; - then `

NOTE

`, only if the trimmed note is non-empty. No other text or whitespace appears. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/order-tracking-timeline.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
